+from pypika import Query, Case, Field as F
+
+# Simple case with else clause
+q = Query.from_('abc').select(Case().when(F('foo') == 1, F('bar')).else_(F('buz')))
+print(f"Test 1 result: {str(q)}")
+print(f"Test 1 expected: SELECT CASE WHEN \"foo\"=1 THEN \"bar\" ELSE \"buz\" END FROM \"abc\"")
+
+# Multi-condition case with else clause  
+q2 = Query.from_('abc').select(Case().when(F('foo') > 0, F('fiz')).when(F('bar') <= 0, F('buz')).else_(1))
+print(f"Test 2 result: {str(q2)}")
+print(f"Test 2 expected: SELECT CASE WHEN \"foo\">0 THEN \"fiz\" WHEN \"bar\"<=0 THEN \"buz\" ELSE 1 END FROM \"abc\"")
